author: Melchior Tamisier-Fayard, Theodoros Evgeniou and Anne-Laure Fayard
basis: Management synthesis drawing on studies, interviews and reported organizational experiments
reported_outcomes: Reports a With Company branding comparison: human-led and heavily AI-supported teams worked in parallel, with the human-led proposal selected. No randomized comparison or retained-skill test.
proposed_outcomes: Preserve alternative framings and make human/AI contributions visible.
limits: The experiment compared two team workflows, not a pure AI system against humans.
Reported counts of images and programs are not evidence of lasting reasoning gains.
Underlying studies and programs need their own review before using their claims as primary evidence.
review_note: Retain the described parallel creative routes; the rest informs context, not a validated intervention package.
coverage: Close-read all six available extracted PDF pages, lines 1–207. Page images not rendered; linked underlying studies not reread.
